title: Love this! So useful to put all my beauty products and hair stuff on :) Easy to see.
text: Love this! So useful to put all my beauty products and hair stuff on :) Easy to see.. Perfect for holding all my stuff now that I live in a smaller apartment my bathroom has less space and it was getting hard to organize everything particularly since I own a lot of hairbands, hairties, beauty products, etc... It really was a livesafer and I like that it has 3 floors. One thing I wasn't too happy about though was that the layers didn't fit completely perfect one on top of the other so when I got it it felt like one was falling off the other I recommend just sticking with placing this one on a corner possibly so it doesn't fall off. Otherwise great product and quite convenient, I like it because I can see everything I have there and it definitely took off some weight from my drawers that were overflowing with just stuff... I might consider buying more if I get a bigger bathroom later on.
